# go-modern-sync-once-value

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use sync.OnceValue to memoize a computed value.

## Details

sync.OnceValue memoizes a computed value safely across goroutines.
It replaces a sync.Once plus a separate result variable and getter closure.

## Examples

### Before

```go
var once sync.Once
var value T
getter := func() T {
  once.Do(func() {
    value = computeValue()
  })
  return value
}
```

### After

```go
getter := sync.OnceValue(func() T {
  return computeValue()
})
```
